subject: [PATCH 08/11] nfsd: apply delegated times in a separate times-only setattr

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch refactors the handling of delegated times in NFSv4 to apply them separately from other attributes. It introduces new fields to hold delegated atime and mtime, and applies these times using a separate function after the main setattr call has completed. This change addresses issues with ownership checks, special ctime handling, and reporting of set attributes when times are rejected. The patch also updates error handling for minor versions that don't support delegated times and removes unnecessary code paths.
